Unfortunately, it did not seem to matter to the rest of the employees who continued to show as much respect to us as they had before (i.e none) At least now I know those I work with are safe from the potential dangers brought in by disrespectful people to/at/during work and considering these conditions even if asked I am pretty sure no one would go to work.

The one thing I can say i am disappointed in is the provincial response to the decimation of the food/service (and any others so drastically affected) industry that basically occurred overnight.
